description: This file defines commands and an action for executing various CVD (Android Virtual Device) operations such as start, stop, remove, powerwash, and power button actions. It includes implementation of command interfaces, command struct types, and a function to run these commands asynchronously within the Cuttlefish orchestrator context.

classes.name: startCvdCommand
classes.description: Command to start a CVD instance.

classes.name: stopCvdCommand
classes.description: Command to stop a CVD instance.

classes.name: removeCvdCommand
classes.description: Command to remove a CVD instance.

classes.name: powerbtnCvdCommand
classes.description: Command to simulate power button press on a CVD.

classes.name: ExecCVDCommandAction
classes.description: Represents an executable action that runs a specified CVD command within the orchestrator.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Method to execute the associated CVD command.

methods.name: NewExecCVDCommandAction
methods.description: Constructor function to create a new ExecCVDCommandAction with specified options.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Runs the command asynchronously and returns an operation handle.
